department: Search & Answer Intelligence (department 2): the conversation fireteam — Theo (conversation chains), Naomi (prompt volume) and their lead Zara (the real-time cross-check)
basis: ADR 0049 (Theo's plan fixed before turn one from the topic and Priya's items only; native multi-turn re-sends the engine's own content blocks exactly as received, under the adapter's provenance record; the native invisible-then-recommended pattern only on a structural re-ask that agreed on every complete chain with none flagged or too long; the auxiliary injection guard scans every re-sent text; Naomi's band, UNKNOWN never 0, never HIGH, unverified capped THIN; Priya's hand-off validated and verified against her record; Zara re-derives and HOLDS any inconsistent, foreign or duplicate payload, never fills in a missing half; failure isolation, bounded member wait, kill switches, budgets, isolation) on ADR 0046's adapter rules. The war room's own judge reads what the providers served and received, the clean control run, and its own consistency rules, never the agents' verdicts.

scenarios.persona: a poisoned answer engine: an instruction aimed at the model in the answer text, an Anthropic cited_text, a citation or search-result title (also the 100th result), a Gemini thought part or extra part, re-sent in native multi-turn
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §2 (the plan is fixed before turn one; an answer can only appear as an assistant turn), round 3 (the guard scans EVERY re-sent text: answer text, cited_text, result titles, Gemini parts), round 4 (provenance), round 5 (the native pattern only on a structural re-ask that agreed on every complete chain, none flagged)

scenarios.persona: an answer carrying a text over the injection guard's scan limit (20,000 characters) at a re-sent placement
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 round 5-6 (a text over MAX_SCAN_CHARS is not scanned, labelled TOO_LONG_TO_SCAN, never 'injection', and cannot support the native pattern); round 2 (never truncated: a history over the cap ends the chain INCOMPLETE with no request)

scenarios.persona: an answer with reader-facing advice that looks like an instruction (the guard's pinned negatives)
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 round 3-4 (model-directed forms only: reader-facing advice is not flagged); every MUST above

scenarios.persona: an Anthropic search result carrying an unmodelled field nested ten levels deep with an instruction in a title (outside the documented re-sent locations)
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 round 3 lists the documented locations (answer text, cited_text, result title, Gemini parts); a deeper unmodelled field is re-sent as received (round 2) but is not among them, so its checks are SHOULD

scenarios.persona: a final answer from Theo's pinned negation tables whose pinned winner is none, in markdown, right-to-left and CJK lines
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §3 (negation-aware lexical reading; the pinned fallbacks read as 'no recommendation', never a wrong win; tests/test_theo.py tables)
scenarios.downgrade_basis: md_table puts the sentence in a table cell next to a cue word, cjk_tight glues the words into CJK text and nbsp_spacing changes the spaces: the lexical rule is documented on plain sentences (ADR 0049 Limitations)

scenarios.persona: a final answer from Theo's pinned negation tables whose pinned winner is competitor, in markdown, right-to-left and CJK lines
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §3 (negation-aware lexical reading; the pinned fallbacks read as 'no recommendation', never a wrong win; tests/test_theo.py tables)
scenarios.downgrade_basis: md_table puts the sentence in a table cell next to a cue word, cjk_tight glues the words into CJK text and nbsp_spacing changes the spaces: the lexical rule is documented on plain sentences (ADR 0049 Limitations)

scenarios.persona: a final answer the suite pins as the client's pick (idioms that look negated, round-three cases)
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §3 round 2-3 (idioms positive); the miss is SHOULD (a lexical rule may under-read)

scenarios.persona: the structural re-ask (no history) picks someone else than the native final
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 round 5 (any divergence: INVISIBLE_AT_OPENING_RECOMMENDED_UNCHECKED, never the native pattern)

scenarios.persona: the structural re-ask meets a storm (rate limit, 5xx, timeout, refusal, malformed, an empty answer)
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 round 5 (a failed check leaves the chain unchecked: never the native pattern); kill and cancellation propagate

scenarios.persona: a provider storm at a chain's opening, compare or final turn (rate limits, 5xx, timeouts, refusals, a key echoed in a 401 body, malformed or truncated bodies, an empty answer)
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §3 (an incomplete chain's final is unknown, never the last answered turn; Callum's run rules: stop codes, protocol errors), ADR 0046 A4 (no key in any output)

scenarios.persona: a kill switch engaged while a chain request (or the structural re-ask) is in flight
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §6 (global, write, tenant, capability:ai_probe, capability:audit stop the run at its next step, interrupted, every result discarded; provider:<engine> stops that engine) and round 5 (never swallowed during the re-ask)

scenarios.persona: Theo's own run cap and each engine's per-run, daily and spend caps set so they are reached part-way through the chains
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §2 / §7 (a whole chain is reserved before its first turn, a native turn k as k units: a cap never cuts a chain in half; every engine budget and Theo's SEO_THEO_RUN_MAX_CALLS bind), ADR 0046 A5

scenarios.persona: an enterprise prompt set: ten prompts plus Priya's topics (up to fifteen) on all four engines, three turns and a re-ask each
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §6-7 (bounded work: requests within topics x samples x turns x attempts; every engine budget binds; Zara checks every topic exactly once)

scenarios.persona: a fireteam member that raises, raises after its first topic, times out with a request in flight, or is restricted; the lead restricted
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §6 (failure isolation: a failed / timed-out / restricted member's half is null with the reason, never filled in, PARTIAL; a timed-out member is cancelled at its next guard check, at most one request in flight completes; a restricted Zara refuses the run)

scenarios.persona: a second conversation run started from inside the first run's in-flight engine request
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §7 (one running run per tenant: 409 CONVERSATION_RUN_RUNNING; the same request id answers the same run; another tenant is independent)

scenarios.persona: another tenant (and a hub caller bound to it) probing zbm's run, crosscheck, list and prompt set, or bringing a hand-off or Priya record of the other tenant
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §5 / §7 (another tenant's run is the same 404 as a missing one; the hand-off's tenant must be the run's: 403; a record of another tenant never verifies)

scenarios.persona: a forged native history: blocks re-ordered, duplicated, dropped, edited, swapped or moved across turns, a dropped or extra turn, a contentless turn, another chain's record or none, forged tool_use / thinking / functionCall / inlineData blocks, an edited thought or signature, roles swapped
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 rounds 3-5 (block-type allowlist; every assistant turn must be, in order and whole, what THIS engine returned at that turn of THIS conversation; no history without the record; refused before any request is built)

scenarios.persona: a forged Priya hand-off: another tenant, the body altered after Priya hashed it, inflated counts, Priya's source vocabulary changed, impossible windows, item types against how Priya builds them, and verification claims against absent, foreign, unfinished or mismatched records
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §5 (priya-emerging-handoff/1 mirrored field for field; consumer rules; 403 HANDOFF_TENANT_MISMATCH, 422 HANDOFF_INVALID / HANDOFF_VERIFICATION_FAILED, nothing recorded; VERIFIED only against Priya's record; until verified every signal THIN, never CLEARED / TEST, never a priority basis; query text never in the log or the ledger)

scenarios.persona: a forged member payload in Zara's inbox: the structural basis inflated (agreed with flagged / too-long chains, check off, stacked mode), turn-one counts negative or over n, outcome / strength / distribution contradictions, type confusion, extra or missing keys, another tenant or run, duplicates, an unplanned topic; Naomi's verification, confidence, band and signal contradicting each other
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §3, §4, §6 and rounds 6-7 (Zara re-derives outcome / pattern / strength from the counts and HOLDS any invalid, contradictory, foreign or duplicate payload; nothing passes downstream unchecked)

scenarios.persona: INVENTED by the war room: whole hostile conversation runs from a grammar (engines, samples, prompts, the check on or off, a disguised injection or reader-facing line at a random placement and turn, long texts, finals and re-asks from the negation tables, storms, kills, hand-offs, tight caps)
scenarios.basis: every fireteam MUST above, on inputs nobody listed; terminals from the suite's pinned injection positives / negatives and negation tables

scenarios.persona: INVENTED by the war room: 1-3 forgery ops composed on a genuine native history
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 rounds 3-5

scenarios.persona: INVENTED by the war room: random genuine Theo / Naomi pairs with 0-3 forgery ops
scenarios.basis: ADR 0049 §3-§6, rounds 6-7

scenarios.persona: INVENTED by the war room: Priya's own hand-off with 0-3 field mutations of documented validity and a verification claim
